# Gray UI

> Gray UI is a monochrome React component library in the shadcn/ui style: 157 copy-paste components — core UI primitives, dashboard cards, a full AI chat suite and a 47-piece loader set — installable through a shadcn-compatible registry with one CLI command.

Gray UI is built by Graytell Labs. Every component is rendered live on the site, ships as plain React + Tailwind CSS source you own, and installs through the standard shadcn CLI from the Gray registry.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gray-ui.vercel.app/): project overview, quick install and highlights.
- [Components](https://gray-ui.vercel.app/components): the full browsable catalog, grouped and searchable, with a live preview for every component.
- [Docs](https://gray-ui.vercel.app/docs): installation, theming and registry reference.
- [Component pages](https://gray-ui.vercel.app/components/button): one page per component (replace `button` with any slug) with a live demo and install command.

## Registry

- [Registry index](https://gray-ui.vercel.app/r/index.json): machine-readable index of every installable item.
- [Per-component JSON](https://gray-ui.vercel.app/r/button.json): shadcn-CLI-compatible registry item (replace `button` with any slug).

## Install

- `npx shadcn@latest add https://gray-ui.vercel.app/r/shimmer.json` installs a component straight from the registry.
- Namespaced install (`@gray/shimmer`) is available after adding the registry to `components.json`; see the docs page.

## Key facts

- 157 components: stock primitives, dashboard cards, AI chat elements and loading animations.
- Strict monochrome design system (zinc palette), dark mode included.
- React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript.
- MIT licensed; source code at https://github.com/GrayTell/Gray-ui
